title: Let the object method read the attributes of this record
goal: Use this in methods called through objects.
summary: Label object can generate label text with its own prefix and number. The start function creates an object with a label method.
tasks: completes the record.label method in rackLabel(prefix, number) and returns a string composed of prefix, hyphen and number.
obtains the return value through record.label(), and the method reads two properties of the current object from this.

example.code:
const item = { name: 'light stand', label() { return this.name; } };
item.label(); // 'Lamp stand'
example.note: When called through item.label(), this points to item. Object methods can use normal method syntax.

hint: method, do not write ordinary methods as arrow functions.
